I like to use this subverse to keep track of important events in Voat's history, as well as keep track of important statements that Putt has made, especially those made outside of the /v/announcements setting, as these comments are often more obscure and less publicly visible. Over the past few months Putt has made a number of statements on Voat's finances and/or donations, and I do not think that I have yet to "preserve" them here, so I will briefly do so now.

28 January 2018, in response to the question "Who is paying for Voats server?": 

[–] PuttItOut [S] 31 points (+31|-0) 1 dog year ago 

Some remaining bitcoin and we reduced costs.

You will see more monetization efforts very soon.

4 March 2018; Putt confirming that bitcoin's increase in value helped bolster Voat's financial situation:

 [–] PuttItOut 6 points (+6|-0) 17 days ago 

You are correct, it is bitcoins increase that has given us a little runway to work with.

5 March 2018; Putt explaining that the BTC address was not removed from the /v/all sidebar, but was incidentally replaced during the Port by older / different code: 

 [–] PuttItOut 4 points (+4|-0) 16 days ago 

The issue with the BTC address (and any Voat specific sections/sidebars/etc) is that these sections in code are custom modifications to the site templates which we generally try not to do because this means someone using Voat code has to manually delete these things when they deploy the code.

Since these are manual modifications, we copy them to the server individually and if/when we do a full publish, these custom changes are overwritten with the standard files, thus appearing to "disappear" from Voat and raise speculation.

The Voat code was never intended to be used at this level and thus we have many nuances to manage and this is one of them.

If you go back and track this I bet you it "disappeared" with the port deployment.

6 March 2018; Putt again confirming that Voat still has a small cushion thanks to bitcoin, and also confirming what I have been speculating, specifically that Putt intends to get the current project out before focusing on donations and financial matters directly:

 [–] PuttItOut 3 points (+3|-0) 16 days ago 

Others have answered this question, but I'll recap: we have a small cushion because of bitcoin. It is short and won't last but I'm trying to get code out before trying to get merchant stuff back up and running.

And we will have to do a honey pot merch round as well as an Amalek one. We are so doing both.

So, for those who are still worried about "Who's funding Voat?" and "Why isn't Putt taking our money?", it basically boils down to: We are funding Voat, still, and Putt doesn't want to engage in donation drives or merch or any of that until the current work he is doing (which will relieve a great deal of his time and also restore a great deal of Voat functionality) is complete.
